title: Intro to AI for Working Professionals
description:
Curious about AI but not sure where to start?

This free mini-course gives working professionals a practical first step into the world of AI — no technical background required.

You'll learn what modern AI can (and can't) do, how professionals are using it today, and how to get started with your first AI workflow.

For any queries regarding this course or the Approachable platform, email me at ranbeer@gmail.com

What You'll Learn

  • What AI is and how it fits into everyday work
  • How to think about AI as a productivity tool, not a replacement
  • Practical first steps to start using AI confidently

Who Is This Course For?

  • Working professionals who are AI Curious
  • Anyone who wants a free, low-commitment starting point before diving deeper

What's Included

  • 3 recorded video lessons
  • 30+ minutes of practical content
  • Lifetime access
instructorBio: Ranbeer Makin is passionate about helping working professionals confidently adopt AI. He has already trained 250+ learners through hands-on workshops and practical courses.
